decision_conditions: The design of the proposed handrails would consitute an incongruous and discordant form of development, that would result in excessive visual clutter and have a harmful impact on the character, appearance and visual amenity of the Grade II Listed Surbiton Railway Station. It is considered that the proposal would constitute less than substantial harm to a designated heritage asset and whilst it is noted that more safe and inclusive access to the railway station may be described as a public benefit, inadequate justification has been provided as to the design of the proposal and whether other reasonable alternatives have been explored that may greater minimise or mitigate the harm identified. The submission also fails to provide information on the anti-slip nosings, tactile pavings, treads and risers proposed. Therefore the proposal would be contrary to Policies HC1 of the London Plan 2021 and CS8, DM10 and DM12 of the RBK core Strategy 2012 and the NPPF 2024.
